messages.content: Predict a human participant's choice in an online decision study. The study consists of two sessions on consecutive days. In the first session, each participant receives $1 and makes one simultaneous, one-shot choice: keep the entire $1, or invest the entire $1 in a group account. Partial investments are unavailable. The group contains at least 35 participants including you; only a minimum group size is specified. Every participant receives 5% of the group account total, whether they invest or keep. Your first-session choice payoff is the money you kept plus 0.05 times the number of participants who invest $1, including your own investment if you invest. Thus, if you keep, your choice payoff is $1 plus this group-account return; if you invest, it is just this return. There is also a $0.50 fee for each session. You must complete both sessions to be paid; choice earnings from both sessions are paid as bonuses after the second session. Other participants' current choices are not revealed before your choice. Return only JSON in the form {"choice":"keep"} or {"choice":"invest"}, with no explanation.

You are the participant making the first-session decision. This is day 1, with no earlier game choices in this study. Your endowment is $1. There is no social-information message and no additional fine or reward contingent on this choice in the current session. Choose keep or invest.
{"choice":"invest"}
